metadata.summary: A hymn in which Agni, the fire, is addressed in his form as Durga, and the fire is asked to carry the chanter across difficulty. It comes from the Krishna Yajurveda, in the Taittiriya Aranyaka and the Mahanarayana Upanishad.
metadata.usage: Chanted in the worship of Devi, for protection and to overcome difficulty.

chunks.sanskrit: ॐ जा॒तवे॑दसे सुनवाम॒ सोम॑मरातीय॒तो निद॑हाति॒ वेदः॑ ।
chunks.translation: We press the soma for Jatavedas; may He consume the malice of our adversaries and dissolve our sins.

chunks.sanskrit: स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॑ ना॒वेव॒ सिन्धुं॑ दुरि॒ताऽत्य॒ग्निः ॥ १ ॥
chunks.translation: May Agni ferry us across all perilous obstacles and perils, as a boat crosses the surging ocean.

chunks.sanskrit: ताम॒ग्निव॑र्णां॒ तप॑सा ज्वल॒न्तीं वै॑रोच॒नीं क॑र्मफ॒लेषु॒ जुष्टाम्᳚ ।
chunks.translation: Her, who is of the fiery luster of Agni, blazing with spiritual power, born of the Sun, worshipped for the fruits of all noble actions,

chunks.sanskrit: दु॒र्गां दे॒वीं शर॑णम॒हं प्रप॑द्ये सु॒तर॑सि तरसे॒ नमः॑ ॥ २ ॥
chunks.translation: To Her, Goddess Durga, I surrender for sanctuary. O Thou who dost bear us safely across, salutations unto Thee!

chunks.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ त्वं पा॑रया॒ नव्यो॑ अ॒स्मान्स्व॒स्तिभि॒रति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा᳚ ।
chunks.translation: O Agni, worthy of ever-new praise, bear us across all difficulties and dangers with Thine auspicious protections.

chunks.sanskrit: पूश्च॑ पृ॒थ्वी ब॑हु॒ला न॑ उ॒र्वी भवा॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय॒ शंयोः ॥ ३ ॥
chunks.translation: May our homes, the broad earth, and all surrounding spaces be expansive and peace-bestowing to our children and offspring.

chunks.sanskrit: विश्वानि॑ नो दु॒र्गहा॑ जातवेदः॒ सिन्धुं॒ न ना॒वा दु॑रि॒ताऽति॑पर्षि ।
chunks.translation: O Jatavedas, carry us across all insurmountable distress and wrongdoing, as a safe vessel carries passengers across the river.
O Agni, praised by us with mind intent like Sage Atri of old, awaken and be the loving protector of our bodies and souls.
We invoke from the highest abode Agni, conqueror of opposing armies, fierce and victorious over all negativity.

chunks.sanskrit: स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॒ क्षाम॑द्दे॒वो अति॑ दुरि॒ताऽत्य॒ग्निः ॥ ५ ॥
chunks.translation: May that radiant Lord Agni transport us safely beyond all barriers and burn away all our impurities.

chunks.sanskrit: प्र॒त्नोषि॑ क॒ममी॑ड्यो अध्व॒रेषु॑ स॒नाच्च॒ होता॒ नव्य॑श्च॒ सत्सि॑ ।
chunks.translation: Thou art praised in the sacred sacrifices, the ancient Hotri priest; seated ever afresh as the divine invoker.

chunks.sanskrit: स्वां चा᳚ग्ने त॒नुवं॑ पि॒प्रय॑स्वा॒स्मभ्यं॑ च॒ सौभ॑ग॒माय॑जस्व ॥ ६ ॥
chunks.translation: O Agni, delight Thy divine being, and grant unto us boundless auspiciousness and spiritual well-being.
Cherished by rays of wisdom, unimpeded and poured forth, may we forever walk in the glorious footsteps of Indra and Vishnu.

chunks.sanskrit: नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठम॒भि सं॒वसा॑नो॒ वैष्ण॑वीं लो॒क इ॒ह मा॑दयन्ताम् ॥ ७ ॥
chunks.translation: Reaching the summit of the heavens, dwelling in the realm of Vishnu, may all souls rejoice in eternal bliss.

chunks.sanskrit: ॐ का॒त्या॒य॒नाय॑ वि॒द्महे॑ कन्यकु॒मारि॑ धीमहि । तन्नो॑ दुर्गिः प्रचो॒दया᳚त् ॥
chunks.translation: May we realize the divine Katyayani; we meditate on the virgin Goddess Kanyakumari. May Goddess Durga guide and illumine our intellect.
